package rpcmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	server "example.com/rpcmembers/gen/jsonrpc/members/server"
	"example.com/rpcmembers/gen/members"
	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMountedServerMemberIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	endpoints := &members.Endpoints{}
	fields := reflect.ValueOf(endpoints).Elem()
	for i := 0; i < fields.NumField(); i++ {
		name := members.MethodNames[i]
		fields.Field(i).Set(reflect.ValueOf(loom.Endpoint(func(ctx context.Context, input any) (any, error) {
			value := reflect.ValueOf(input).Elem()
			payload := value
			stream := value.FieldByName("Stream")
			if stream.IsValid() {
				payload = value.FieldByName("Payload").Elem()
			}
			if payload.FieldByName("Value").Elem().String() != "incoming" {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("wrong payload for %s", name)
			}
			result := name + ":incoming"
			if !stream.IsValid() {
				return result, nil
			}
			method := stream.MethodByName("SendResponse")
			if !method.IsValid() {
				method = stream.MethodByName("SendAndClose")
			}
			results := method.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(ctx), reflect.ValueOf(result)})
			if !results[0].IsNil() {
				return nil, results[0].Interface().(error)
			}
			return nil, nil
		})))
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	@@NEW@@
	var wrapped atomic.Int32
	srv.Use(func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			wrapped.Add(1)
			w.Header().Set("X-Wrapped", "yes")
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
	server.Mount(mux, srv)
	const kind = "@@KIND@@"
	if kind == "server" || kind == "bidi" || kind == "keywords" {
		peer := httptest.NewServer(mux)
		defer peer.Close()
		conn, _, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws"+strings.TrimPrefix(peer.URL, "http")+"/rpc", nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, int32(1), wrapped.Load())
		defer func() {
			require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
		}()
		for _, name := range members.MethodNames {
			require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":%q,"params":{"value":"incoming"},"id":7}`, name))))
			require.NoError(t, conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)))
			_, wire, err := conn.ReadMessage()
			require.NoError(t, err, name)
			var result struct {
				ID int `json:"id"`
				Result string `json:"result"`
			}
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(wire, &result))
			require.Equal(t, 7, result.ID, string(wire))
			require.Equal(t, name+":incoming", result.Result, string(wire))
		}
		return
	}
	for _, name := range members.MethodNames {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/rpc", strings.NewReader(fmt.Sprintf(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":%q,"params":{"value":"incoming"},"id":7}`, name)))
			r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			if kind == "sse" || (kind == "mixed" && name != "read") {
				r.Header.Set("Accept", "text/event-stream")
			}
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code, w.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, "yes", w.Header().Get("X-Wrapped"))
			wire := w.Body.String()
			if r.Header.Get("Accept") != "" {
				require.Contains(t, w.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "text/event-stream")
				_, wire, _ = strings.Cut(wire, "data: ")
				wire, _, _ = strings.Cut(wire, "\n")
			}
			var result struct {
				ID int `json:"id"`
				Result string `json:"result"`
			}
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &result))
			require.Equal(t, 7, result.ID, wire)
			require.Equal(t, name+":incoming", result.Result, wire)
		})
	}
}
